description: Change the account's quality settings (dashboard: Settings > Qualities); send only what changes. encoding ("Conversão de Novos Uploads"): qualities NEW uploads are converted to, each one using storage. playback ("Reprodução de Todos Vídeos"): qualities the player offers on ALL videos, including the ones already uploaded, when converted in that quality. compression_mode ("Compressão de Novos Uploads", NEW uploads): Econômica (size, smaller files), Equilibrada (balanced) or Maior qualidade (quality, larger files). keep_original_files ("Backup do Arquivo Original de Novos Uploads"): keep the original file of NEW uploads (uses storage; when off, downloads only offer the converted versions). Existing videos are not re-encoded (use panda_reencode_video). Not available on the Clipador/Clipper plan and needs the permission to change account settings (put-general-config); both are checked before changing.

compression_mode.description: Econômica / Equilibrada / Maior qualidade (or size / balanced / quality)

encoding.description: Qualities new uploads are converted to (240p, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 2160p; 2160p = 4K); the whole list, at least one

keep_original_files.description: true = keep the original file of new uploads

playback.description: Qualities the player offers (240p, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 1440p, 2160p; 2160p = 4K); the whole list, at least one

name: panda_update_library_qualities
title: Update Library Qualities
